content.comment_body: Hello everyone, when uploading logic files from a [product_name] unit or opening files from other sources, is there a way to ensure the layout appears as it was originally created? Thanks to everyone!

Hi, when you upload or open a file, it always appears in the format in which it was saved. Try making changes, saving, downloading, and then uploading again to see the results. Or simply open the saved file. I am not entirely certain, though.
Hello, I attempted the approach of resaving files but it did not work. I was wondering if there is a default setting that needs to be adjusted so the appearance fills the workspace proportionally.

Hi, if your question concerns the positions of function blocks on the workspace, then the answer is no. I believe position data is not stored in [product_name]. After uploading, you may find different positions in FDB format. You can try LAD format, which might help.

analysis.insight_summary: Users face challenges retaining the visual arrangement of logic files after uploading from a [product_name] unit or opening files from other sources. The main usability issue is that function block positions and overall layout are not preserved, impacting the visual consistency and design workflow. Attempts to save and re-upload did not solve the issue, revealing a limitation in the product's data handling.
analysis.user_expectations: Users want the visual layout and arrangement of blocks in uploaded or opened logic files to stay exactly as originally created, with the workspace filling proportionally and the design fully preserved.
